Jordan C: looping in legal and platform for OrchidAI DPA addendum + embeddings retention attestation. Customer asked for an evidence walkthrough and a short checklist. ETA end of week?
Priya S: happy to run the walkthrough. can you share the exact asks from the customer? short bullet list would help.
Jordan C: pasted the snippet from their email below — main asks: 1) confirm where embeddings are stored and our retention TTL, 2) BYOK/KMS attestation (key provenance only), 3) short SOC2 scope statement covering non-prod embeddings processing, 4) one-pager + evidence bundle. they want a 30m call thursday morning PT.
Emily (OrchidAI): confirmation — yes thursday morning PT would be ideal. we need the one-pager before the call if possible. we'll upload evidence to the secure link you give.
Marco L: THU 10am PT works for me. i can demo storage paths, region mapping, and the embeddings lifecycle (TTL + snapshots).
Nadia R: i will draft the BYOK attestation language and the minimal KMS provenance statement. include me on the calendar invite.
Jordan C: invite recipients: @Priya S, @Marco L, @Nadia R, Emily (OrchidAI). Draft agenda below.
Jordan C: Agenda (draft):
- 5m intro / scope
- 10m embeddings storage & retention (Marco)
- 5m BYOK/KMS attestation language (Nadia)
- 5m SOC2 scope clarifications (Priya)
- 5m next steps & upload instructions
Priya S: quick checklist draft pasted — please skim and comment: 
```
1) One-pager: embeddings storage location, retention TTL, snapshot cadence (PDF)
2) Evidence: sample storage path + region config, retention policy doc, access logs snippet (last 30 days)
3) KMS attestation: key id format, owner contact, rotation cadence, proof of rotation policy (statement only)
4) SOC2 coverage: list of controls relevant to embeddings processing (non-prod access controls, env segregation, logging)
5) Upload: secure link + instructions, naming convention for files
```
Marco L: i'll produce the one-pager and a small demo script to show how to export a storage snapshot. aim: Wed EOD.
Priya S: i'll validate this checklist against our onboarding playbook and flag any gaps (ETA Wed EOD).
Nadia R: attestation template ready — i'll tailor the wording for OrchidAI and send to Jordan for review by Wed EOD. note: we only assert control descriptions, not customer key material.
Jordan C: action items recap: Marco -> one-pager + demo Wed EOD; Priya -> playbook validation Wed EOD; Nadia -> attestation template Wed EOD; Jordan -> schedule invite + upload secure folder + confirm upload process.
onboarding-bot: Reminder created: 'OrchidAI DPA walkthrough' Thu 10:00 PT. Calendar invites sent.
Emily (OrchidAI): perfect, thanks everyone — we'll plan to upload the preliminary files to the SFTP link you sent earlier. one-pager before the call would be great.
Jordan C: thanks team — i'll follow up tomorrow with the invite and upload link. :thumbsup:
